name: best_vary_n_select
description: Single-axis: number of curated points added. Anchored at the 10-seed joint-search sweet spot (deeper undertrained regime + wide kernel, warm-start): n_bumps 5, noise_std 0.05, radius 0.25, iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sel_sigma 0.5, n_select 100, mix_ratio 0.5, iters_retrain 400, Weakpoint distance. At this anchor guided beats the random baseline over the WHOLE area ~75-85% of the time (gap ~-0.25) and fixes the weakspot hard. Default detector trio = strong, diverse detectors here (Quantile Regression, Peaks over Threshold (EVT), RBF Interpolation); 20 seeds. Sweeps n_select [25..2000] to see how much curated data the whole-area win needs (more points also help the random baseline, so the gap shrinks). Extended toward n_candidate=2000, where guided selects (nearly) the whole pool and converges to the random baseline (gap -> 0).
